invariant_argument: The explicit policy and body map distinguish literal metadata predicates from the mathematical concepts named by the file. Ordered finite String checks map to MetadataValidation; ShapeInventory separately checks boundary equality, positive/optional counts, conditional label binding and all typed context variants. No mathematical category or universal-property hypothesis is silently assumed.

Each iterator borrows a finite actual Vec/BTreeMap; the prefix invariant preserves prior field/entry checks and returns the first failure. Category splits these three ordered inventories into cohesive private helpers, preserving call order and propagating every typed refusal with ?. No validator changes the raw record or returns a retained proof token.

Nested parent checks run own fields first, then the actual child, then later constraints. Limit/Colimit use the actual same-parent Cone shape-context helper. Its match exhaustively maps InvalidShape detail while forwarding every other enum variant unchanged. The checked contextualize model proves no child error becomes success.

Std String equality/is_empty, Vec/BTreeMap iteration/length and formatting implement the declared primitive relation. Product/Coproduct use only exact usize lengths/comparisons, no arithmetic/narrowing. No unchecked production index, division, recursion or user callback occurs in validation. Standard constructor conversion/allocator behavior remains the explicit runtime boundary.

Native test namespaces compile inside the actual Rust parent modules, retaining original visibility and actual peer providers. Only the isolated snapshot gains serde_json as a test dependency for case decoding. Candidate files live under that package and are included in dependency-content binding; no production visibility is widened.
